test_title: SSC Stenographer 2023 Official Paper (Held On: 13 Oct, 2023 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate option that can substitute the underlined segment in the given sentence.

She is strictly advised to be on bed for three weeks lest __she would fall sick again__.

options.text: lest she will fall sick again
lest she should fall sick again
lest she can fall sick again
lest she shall fall sick again

solution:
The correct answer is **'Option 2.'**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The construction **"lest" **is used to indicate a precautionary measure to avoid a negative outcome. 
 
• Following **"lest,"** the subjunctive mood is used to express a possible but not certain event.
 
• In the subjunctive mood, the base form of the verb (**without "would" or "should"**) is used after** "lest."**
 
• Hence, the correct form is** "lest she should fall sick again."**

Therefore, the correct answer is** 'Option 2.'**

Correct Sentence__: She is strictly advised to be on bed for three weeks** lest she should fall sick again.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 1) lest she will fall sick again**: This option uses "will," which is not appropriate in the subjunctive mood.
 
• **Option 3) lest she can fall sick again**: This option uses "can," which is not appropriate in the subjunctive mood.
 
• **Option 4) lest she shall fall sick again: **This option uses "shall," which is not appropriate in the subjunctive mood.
